objective: Test a dataset-faithful decoder that preserves the parent aspect decisions and automatically adds at most one runner-up sentiment.
provenance: Sequential follow-up designed after reviewing taxonomy_multi_sentiment_decoder_validation_v1; retain that v1 result as immutable exploratory evidence.

data_contract.representation: name_and_description for seen and held-out aspects
data_contract.training_filter: remove every official training row containing the fold's held-out aspect

aspect_decoder.rule: retain every aspect_score greater than or equal to the parent Study C seen-validation threshold

argmax_control.sentiment_rule: emit exactly the highest-scoring sentiment for every selected aspect

capped_two_decoder.sentiment_rule: always emit the highest-scoring sentiment and additionally emit the runner-up only when its score reaches the seen-validation-selected second-sentiment threshold
capped_two_decoder.threshold_candidates: all strict candidates induced by runner-up scores of parent-selected seen-validation aspect instances, plus a value above the maximum that exactly reproduces argmax
capped_two_decoder.threshold_objective: end-to-end pair micro-F1 on seen-aspect validation with the parent aspect threshold frozen
tie_breakers: fewer selected aspects receiving a second sentiment

primary_metric: held-out pair micro-F1, unweighted mean across folds
secondary_metrics: held-out pair micro precision and recall
rate of selected aspects receiving a second sentiment
gold-sentiment recall on two-sentiment review-aspect instances
fold wins ties losses against argmax
stopping_rules: any change to the parent aspect threshold
more than two sentiments emitted for one aspect
failure to reproduce the parent argmax control
reporting_rule: Report this as a sequential validation follow-up and retain negative results; do not modify v1 or parent Study C.
